evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic maxim rendering a technical-rehearsal mandate into plain, memorable folk wisdom — the document's register signature crystallized in one line.

mints.title: plain-spoken aphorism that crystallizes a technical mandate into memorable folk wisdom
mints.frame: Is the expression restating a technical requirement as a maxim whose memorability is itself the compliance mechanism?
